event_description: User attempts to sign in via Google OAuth or password.
User explicitly signs out of the app.
Player selects a district and comfort level and enters the game world.
Player leaves a district and returns to the title screen.
Player initiates a conversation with an NPC to begin an errand.
Player successfully completes an errand and earns a cash reward.
Player's spoken language attempt is transcribed and scored in a dialogue lesson.
Roznamcha health worker submits a spoken utterance for field record extraction.
Roznamcha health worker successfully files a completed household visit record.
Server confirms an NPC errand real-world outcome was achieved in conversation.
Server successfully files a Roznamcha household visit record to the store.
